caption:
Woolworths has put its hand up for both home Rugby World Cups.

It's the Official Supermarket Supporter of the men's Rugby World Cup 2027 and the women's Rugby World Cup 2029, both played here. No fee or length was disclosed. The bigger play is Cartology, Woolworths' retail media network, which will open up brand opportunities around the tournaments.

Also today: Stripe x Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team, AT&T x NBA, AbbVie x McLaren, Topgolf x John Daly.
